message:
arm64: dts: qcom: sm8550-xiaomi-fuxi: single consolidated board dts

Fold sm8550-xiaomi-fuxi-min.dts and the disp, audio, audio2, modem and
usbc fragments, plus the DisplayPort controller, into one self-contained
board file. It compiles to the same tree as the daily
sm8550-xiaomi-fuxi-r120idle-mic-rupdclk-modem-audio-disp-usbc-dp.dtb

author: codex
message:
fuxi: splash reserved-memory iommu-addresses + sm8550-mdss identity domain

The bootloader leaves MDSS autorefresh scanning the splash buffer at
0xb8000000. Once the SMMU attaches a translating domain to the MDSS SID
(0x1c00) every fetch faults until DPU takes over, which shows as a
corrupted screen for ~0.7 s during boot.

- DTS: describe the splash region with iommu-addresses and point mdss
  memory-region at it, so a 1:1 direct mapping is requested.
- arm-smmu-qcom: add qcom,sm8550-mdss to qcom_smmu_client_of_match like
  the other MDSS generations, so the device starts in an identity domain
  (the direct mapping alone could not be installed before attach and
  one fault remained).

Tested on Xiaomi 13 (deb4/deb5): context faults 10 -> 1 -> 0, panel and
DPU work.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
